turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Sam Whitfield. I have fifteen minutes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks, Sam. HyperSale cuts manager coaching time with AI voice roleplays and quote-backed scoring, revealing weekly rep improvement before quota slips.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Why is this worth forty-eight thousand dollars? Give me the expected impact on ramp time, win rate, or failed hires.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: The AI gives every rep realistic buyer practice and managers quote-backed scoring, so coaching focuses quickly. Could we review your baseline metrics next week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Not without a quantified case: what reduction in ramp time or attrition do you expect? Forty-eight thousand is above my thirty-five-thousand-dollar ceiling—what can you do on price, and what specific date next week do you propose with our VP of Sales?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: At $35,000, we’d reduce scope below 40 reps; I won’t invent impact. Can you and your VP review baselines Tuesday, November 3 at 2 Eastern?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Tuesday, November 3 at 2 Eastern works if it is a business-case review with our VP and includes a 40-rep option at $35,000 or less, plus quantified ramp-time or attrition assumptions. Send me the business case and we'll take it from there.
